1. Care has made all add-ons optional (which were previously mandatory like Air ambulance, wellness benefit, AHC, OPD, Bonus riders, etc)  for all Care plans except some specific variants like Care Supreme Shine, Care Supreme - Senior Super, Care Supreme Senior Premium, etc.
Note: Health Check+ add-on is no longer mandatory for Insulin dependent insured members under Care Freedom Policy.

Care add-ons will still be mandatory when doing the applications via Faveo.

2. Payment Specific: Try not to do the payment through Faveo unless its absoulutely required. If we are using Faveo for the payment due to an unavoidable reason, please inform the lead that the mandatory riders can be removed during the next renewal.

Changes have been made live on the payment journey, product playbook and premium tools along with the website.

Rating Implication

1. If any advisor wrongly informs that any particular rider is mandatory in any of the Care plans except the specific variants like Care Supreme Shine, Care Supreme - Senior Super, Care Supreme Senior Premium, etc then it would be marked under rating 3. 
2. A few riders that were mandatory previously have now been made non-mandatory, however Ditto will still actively pitch as "recommended" for a few of them as per Product Playbook Update. Not pitching the same would be rated 3
3. Payment Specific - Not informing the lead that they can remove the mandatory riders at the time of renewal if the payment is done through Faveo would be rated 3

HDFC KYC

We have observed that even if there is any discrepancy in the name or DOB during the KYC stage, some advisors are proceeding with the payment.

When the KYC is fetched ask the customer to check the name and DOB carefully if its the same as Govt ID or not. If its not the same, suggest the customer to reschedule the call and in the meantime we can get the KYC deleted and then we can try again. If the KYC details fetched are wrong even after deleting it, considering the hassle for the customer we can login such cases by letting telling the customer to get the correct details endorsed post purchase.

Rating Implication

Not letting the customer know to get the correct details endorsed post purchase.would be rated 3
